_note: Settings for the repair-priority list and the pipe suspects. Values marked 'assumption' should be replaced with the utility's own figures.
_household_note: assumption: average water use of one household, used to turn the demand in a search area into a number of households

suspects._note: Pipes are grouped into square blocks of stretch_size_m, named after their main street. Each pipe is rated by its search-area likelihood and its distance to the best guess (location_spread_m). Tested on 64 simulated leaks: the leak was in the first block 27% of the time, in the top 3 blocks 47%, in the top 5 blocks 67%.
